text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The spring of the Classic year comes to a close—
and the season for Summer Camp has arrived!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mood! Renewed! Refreeeeshed!
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, after the Derby, El wasn't quite acting like herself!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Moping around isn't El's style at all!
After all, El is the child of the sun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's 'Niño del Sol'!
After all, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What must I do to become the true strongest in the world!?
What is the path I must take?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna worry either way,
I might as well worry cheerily at the training camp, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all,
it seems she's cheered up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Still, El, is it really all right for you to go off to training camp?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If both of us head out by bus,
what about Mambo-kun back in the room～……

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, oops! I totally slipped up~...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mambo is the name of El's pet condor, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El...! Geez~. Why did you have to go
and blab to the Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even though pets technically
aren't allowed in the dorm rooms...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, though strictly speaking it's a hawk, not a condor.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass! When it comes to Mambo, no
problem! You don't need to worry about a thing!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But what about feeding him...?
He eats so much, too...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You'll understand the reason once we depart, yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vrrrrooooom!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the bus departed,
leaving the pet behind...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh, Trainer-san, look out the window at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Aaah, Mambo-kun...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mambo, *bueno*! Keep it up, *desu*!
Fly all the way to the training camp in one go!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: With the wings of a condor, it's nothing at all, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pet that can come along without having to ride the bus.
That certainly puts any worries to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Echoing loud and clear, that cry...
was unmistakably that of a hawk.
